subject: bonnethead shark
title: A Hammerhead Shark Eats Seagrass Salad and Digests It

scenes.text: There's a shark that eats salad.
The bonnethead is a small hammerhead. For years, scientists thought its seagrass was an accident.
Then researchers fed bonnetheads seagrass labeled with carbon and tracked where it went.
Seagrass made up more than half of their diet, and the sharks digested about half of it.
Their guts even have enzymes that break down plant fiber.
So yes, a shark that eats salad. The only other known omnivorous shark is the whale shark.

description:
The bonnethead is a hammerhead shark that eats seagrass on purpose.
A 2018 study found it digests about half of the seagrass organic matter and has plant-digesting enzymes in its gut.
Which animal would you never expect to eat plants? Comment below.
first_comment: Shark or vegetarian? Which other predator do you think secretly eats plants?
